:::{#exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome as a squared deviation

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision,
starting from the [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution $\hess_\iobs(\prob)$ in @cor-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision,
write $\hess_\iobs(\prob)$ with the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$
as a multiple of $\sqf{\precision}$ times the square of the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs \eqdef \outvar_\iobs - \prob$.
Hint: because $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$, $\sqf{\outvar_\iobs} = \outvar_\iobs$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction}

Starting from @cor-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision, factor out $\sqf{\precision}$.
The reciprocal of the precision is $1 / \precision = \prob(1 - \prob)$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
&= -\precision - \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision} \devn_\iobs
&& \text{(the contribution from the corollary)}\\
&= -\sqf{\precision} \frac{1}{\precision} - \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision} \devn_\iobs
&& \text{($\precision = \sqf{\precision} / \precision$)}\\
&= -\sqf{\precision} \paren{\prob(1 - \prob) + \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \devn_\iobs}
&& \text{(factor out $-\sqf{\precision}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The factor in parentheses is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prob(1 - \prob) + \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \devn_\iobs
&= \prob - \sqf{\prob} + \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \paren{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}
&& \text{(distribute $\prob$; definition of $\devn_\iobs$)}\\
&= \prob - \sqf{\prob} + \outvar_\iobs - \prob - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + 2 \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{(distribute $1 - 2 \prob$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \paren{2 \sqf{\prob} - \sqf{\prob}} + \paren{\prob - \prob}
&& \text{(reorder and group the terms)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob} + 0
&& \text{($2 a - a = a$ and $a - a = 0$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}\\
&= \sqf{\outvar_\iobs} - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{($\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$, so $\outvar_\iobs = \sqf{\outvar_\iobs}$)}\\
&= \sqf{\paren{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}}
&& \text{(square of a difference)}\\
&= \sqf{\devn_\iobs}
&& \text{(definition of $\devn_\iobs$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the factor back in:

$$
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
= -\sqf{\precision} \sqf{\devn_\iobs}
\qquad \text{(substitute $\sqf{\devn_\iobs}$)}
$$

:::
